entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's a good thing we obtained that ID card.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Remember, none of us have seen the area[n]beyond the door that takes that ID card.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: There's no telling what sort of traps[n]we could encounter. We should[n]proceed with caution.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Meh, we got plenty of experience with[n]this shit now. We'll be fine!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Wow... Spoken like a true veteran,[n]Skull-senpai!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: At this point, I feel like I should interject[n]to point out that none of us have ANY[n]experience coming this far here.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It never hurts to be cautious, folks.
